title: LandlordGuard Pay-Off Late-Payment Load — Collections Pricing Note
content:
**Note.** The pay-off of a LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy term carries a late-payment load that counts the late fees posted on the policy in the 24 calendar months up to the pay-off date: two or more give 2 percent; exactly one gives 1 percent; none gives 0 percent.

The late-payment load prices the collection cost that a record of late installments adds to the premium still unbilled. It is added into the pay-off percentage, which is applied once to the unbilled premium of the current term.

| Late fees posted on the policy, 24 calendar months up to the pay-off date | Late-payment load |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 2 percent |
| exactly 1 | 1 percent |
| none | 0 percent |

## Counting

Each late-fee entry on this policy's premium account counts once, by the date it was posted; installment fees and returned-payment fees are not late fees.

## Hypothetical accounts

| Late fees on the account | Load |
|---|---|
| posted 3 and 20 months before the pay-off date | 2 percent |
| posted 3 and 25 months before the pay-off date | 1 percent |
| none | 0 percent |

On a hypothetical unbilled premium of 1,000.00 USD, a pay-off percentage of 2 percent adds 20.00 USD to that premium.
